eval.description: OpenAI short-answer eval of tacit wet-lab troubleshooting on non-public expert-written protocols. Experts supply protocols and three realistic failure questions each (52 protocols after review). Graded for accuracy or pass@1 against expert fixes; cards use an 80th-percentile PhD expert score as an indicative threshold, and some treat refusals as successes. Dataset and runner are lab-internal.
eval.summary: Tests whether the model can find and fix problems in expert wet-lab protocols when experiments fail.

versions.changes: 52 expert protocols with three troubleshooting questions each; 12-expert baselining on OpenAI cards.

scores.description: The short answer correctly identifies and fixes the protocol error (refusal-as-success variants count a refusal as correct on some cards).

metrics.description: Share of questions graded correct. Cards also cite an 80th-percentile expert threshold.
